in_marathi.name: Bijuli
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lightning, Bright, Shining
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bijuli हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bijuli is a name of Sanskrit and Bengali origin meaning 'Lightning' or 'Bright'. The name signifies the radiance and vitality of life, and the energy that lights up the world around us. Bijuli is a name for those who are bright and shining in their own unique way.
